ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Travel Reporting. Freshmen will spend time exploring Champaign-Urbana with an eye as a travel reporter. Students will examine and evaluate various types of travel writing with the goal of producing a travel story that not only informs, but educates prospective tourists and newly arrived residents about the development and attractions of Champaign-Urbana. Using a journalistic storytelling approach, students will each weave facts and interview quotes into a story about Champaign-Urbana. For more information go to: HTMLCONTROL Forms.HTML:Text.1. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course.
